title: Trade Offer
description: A single team's outgoing trade offer to another team (PLAN.md §4 step 5: max one outgoing offer per team per week).

to_team.description: Team slug of the offer's target (must match a teams/<slug> directory).

out.description: Player ids the offering team gives up.

in.description: Player ids the offering team wants back.

message.description: Optional in-character note attached to the offer.

drop.description: Player ids YOU cut to make room, required only when this offer takes back more players than it sends and your roster is full. Never players in 'out' or 'in'.
